# AI Governance for Leaders — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 2 — Map your systems to risk tiers

*Module 2: The frameworks, decoded · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_map_systems_to_tiers.py`): List every AI system your function uses (include the ones IT does not know about). Classify each with /tools → Governance. Which surprised you?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Design your review process

*Module 3: Structure and roles · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_review_process_design.py`): Set REQUESTS to your own expected pipeline. Is one board meeting a month enough? What would you delegate to make it flow?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Metrics and reporting
